section4.sectionaria: Story about the founder of LysLan
section4.imgalt: The founder of LysLan, the beautiful lady behind the handcrafted chocolates.
section4.h3: “LysLan began with a longing — and grew from a dream to share the soul of Vietnamese flavor with the world...”

letter.p1: At LysLan, heritage and creativity are delicately woven into every chocolate creation. With a deep passion for Vietnamese culture and flavors, our founder held a heartfelt dream: to bring the distinctive tastes of her homeland to the world — from iconic ingredients like fish sauce, tamarind stone, and iced milk coffee, to beloved local produce such as honey lime, cashews, and strawberries — all reimagined into bold, innovative bonbons.
letter.p2: Every piece of LysLan chocolate is not only a sweet gift, but a sophisticated fusion of global flavor and meticulous French-inspired craftsmanship. The founder’s journey across the world wasn’t merely about sourcing premium ingredients — it was about distilling the essence of Vietnamese culinary heritage into each bonbon, creating a product that is both unique and meaningful.
letter.p3: LysLan chocolate is the perfect union of cultural heritage and artistic innovation. We use only the finest ingredients and precise techniques to craft an experience like no other. With every bonbon, we invite you into a multicultural journey where tradition meets modern artistry — leaving an unforgettable impression with each bite.

section1.sectionaria: LysLan - Born from a Vietnamese dream
section1.h2: “LysLan began with a simple dream: to bring the flavors of Vietnam to the world through chocolate. Each chocolate piece embodies passion and a deep belief in the true values of our homeland.”
section1.imgtitle: CEO Đoàn Nhược Lan and COD Serge Perrin Merinos
section1.h3: LysLan – Bringing Vietnamese Flavors to Every Chocolate Piece
section1.p1: LysLan's journey began with the story of a female entrepreneur who had the opportunity to experience and learn about chocolate from various countries around the world through business trips and meetings.
section1.p2: Yet, despite tasting the finest international chocolates, she always felt something subtly missing—the unique cocoa nuances and familiar flavors from her Vietnamese heritage.
section1.p3: Driven by this inspiration, she nurtured the idea to establish LysLan with the aim of delicately infusing Vietnamese flavors into each piece of chocolate. LysLan emerged with handcrafted bonbons, filled chocolate bars, and chocolate-covered nuts, not only celebrating the authentic values of Vietnamese cocoa and traditional flavors but also elegantly blending tradition and modernity to deliver a gentle, refined, and deeply nostalgic experience.
section1.p4: At LysLan, chocolate becomes a medium to gently narrate stories of Vietnam, where each chocolate piece carries heartfelt emotion and meticulous attention to detail.

banner.title: Frequently Asked Questions
banner.h1: Every question brings you closer to a perfect experience.
banner.p: We have prepared all the information you need—from products, delivery, to tips for enjoying flavors with finesse.

shipping.A1: Currently, Lyslan delivers to Ho Chi Minh City, Thu Dau Mot, Di An, Thuan An (Binh Duong), and Bien Hoa. For areas outside this range, an additional shipping fee may apply. We are expanding our delivery network to better serve you.
shipping.A2: We currently do not offer standard international shipping. However, if you have special needs, please contact us directly, and we will discuss and try to assist within our capabilities.
shipping.Q3: How is the shipping fee calculated?
shipping.A3: The shipping fee is based on the delivery address and the shipping method you choose. Before your order is confirmed, you will be clearly notified of the shipping cost to ensure peace of mind when making payment.
shipping.A4: In Ho Chi Minh City and Binh Duong, orders are usually delivered within 48 hours. For other areas like Bien Hoa or neighboring provinces, the expected delivery time is 3–5 working days, depending on the distance and the delivery service. Lyslan always strives to deliver chocolate quickly and with its full flavor.
shipping.Q5: How can I track my order?
shipping.A5: Before shipping, the delivery partner will contact you for confirmation. Additionally, you can call our hotline at 097 506 64 06 to check the order status or receive support at any time during business hours.

order.Q1: What channels can I use to place an order?

A1.p1: You can place an order directly through:
A1.p4: Hotline for fast orders and consultations
A1.p5: Lyslan is always ready to assist you on whichever channel is most convenient for you.

order.Q2: What payment methods does Lyslan support?

A2.p1: We accept various flexible payment methods:
A2.p5: All are safe and transparent, and you can choose the method that best suits you.

order.Q3: Can I change or cancel my order after placing it?
order.A3: Yes. If you need to adjust your order, please contact us as soon as possible via the hotline before the order is processed. We will try to assist with adjustments or cancellations based on the current status of the order.

FAQs.Q4: How else can I place an order besides the website?
FAQs.A4: You can order Lyslan's chocolate via Shopee. If you encounter any issues while placing an order, don’t hesitate to contact us directly – the Lyslan team is always ready to assist you quickly and professionally.
FAQs.Q5: How can I place a corporate gift order or a large order with custom packaging?
FAQs.A5: Please send us your contact details and specific requirements, including the expected quantity, delivery time, and packaging ideas (if any). Lyslan's team will quickly reach out to advise and assist you throughout the preparation of professional and thoughtful corporate gifts.
FAQs.Q6: Can I order in bulk for distribution?
FAQs.A6: Yes. If you are interested in distributing Lyslan products, please share your contact information and specific requirements. The business department will get in touch with you soon to discuss details.
FAQs.Q7: What if I receive a faulty product?
FAQs.A7: We are sorry if the product you received does not meet expectations. Please contact us via Zalo, Facebook, or hotline 097 506 64 06 to report the order status. We guarantee to respond and resolve the issue immediately, ensuring that you are always fully cared for and satisfied.
FAQs.Q8: Can I request a VAT invoice?

A8.p1: Yes. You can request a VAT invoice on the day of purchase:
A8.p2: If buying in-store: please inform the cashier when making payment.
A8.p3: If buying online: just fill in the information in the 'Request Invoice' section when placing your order.
A8.p4: We will process the invoice details along with your order accurately and quickly.

product.Q1: How should I store Lyslan products?
product.A1: To maintain the flavor and quality, you should store chocolate in a dry, cool place, away from direct sunlight. The ideal temperature is 18–24°C. If necessary, you can place it in the fridge, but it should be consumed soon after removal to avoid changing the texture and flavor.
product.Q2: Does Lyslan offer products suitable for vegetarians?
product.A2: Yes. Some of Lyslan's products do not contain animal-derived ingredients and are suitable for vegetarians. You can check the ingredients in each product on our website or contact us for more details.
product.Q3: Where can I view the product menu?
product.A3: The full menu is always updated on Lyslan's official website. You can also send a message via our fanpage if you want advice on product selection (gifts, flavor experiences, etc.).
product.Q4: Why does my chocolate have white streaks or spots?

A4.p1: This is a natural phenomenon called 'bloom'—common, especially with high-quality or pure chocolate.
A4.p2: It occurs when the chocolate undergoes sudden temperature changes or is stored in unsuitable humidity and temperature conditions.
A4.p4: The product is not spoiled and the flavor or internal quality is not affected, only the external appearance changes slightly.
A4.p5: To minimize bloom, store chocolate in a dry, cool place with an ideal temperature of 18–24°C, away from sunlight or heat sources.

other.Q1: How can I contact you for further support?
other.A1: We are always ready to assist you. Call our hotline at 097 506 64 06 or email lyslanchocolatier@gmail.com for quick and dedicated support.
other.A2: We frequently have special promotions for loyal customers or during holidays. You can follow updates on our website, or on Lyslan's official Facebook or Instagram pages.
